name: dhriti-portfolio
description: MERN portfolio of Dhriti Gupta: React + Vite client, Express + MongoDB API.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
